verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a first-party bulk-operation feature, such as applying one action across many issues, PRs, repos, or files in a single operation. The SDK note on running multiple agent tasks in parallel via `asyncio.gather()` is a developer building block for constructing such behavior, not the capability itself. The PR-triage workflow (docs-20) is one specific automation, not general bulk operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
